goal: Reference-locked church asset reconstruction with commercial-safe output and zero-cost-first tooling.
production_strategy: Do not trust one-shot generative 3D as final geometry.
Trace front/side silhouettes from the supplied sheets and constrain the authored mesh to that visual hull.
Use sketch/retopo tools for Gothic relief and small features.
Use AI image-to-3D only as a candidate high-poly source; accept it only after silhouette and runtime gates.
Keep PBR/material generation separate from geometry fitting so baked lighting is not copied into albedo.
When GPU access exists, use Pixal3D multi-view as a high-detail proposal, then force the result through our traced silhouette cages and runtime gates rather than trusting generation alone.
For interactive sculpt/retopo work, BlendRelay can overlay references and viewport sketches while preserving selected geometry/checkpoints.
Add a camera-locked silhouette IoU score to CI and accept geometry edits only when the reference score improves; never trade a worse visual match for a passing runtime gate.
